zh-CN.drawer.label: 活动详情
zh-CN.mega.intro: 选择一只宝可梦，填入它已超级进化的次数，规划器会动态比较三条升级路线：免费等满休息期（7 / 5 / 3 天）、每天付费进化一次、花能量立即升级。下方附静态查询表（各等级消耗、通用加成、立即升级价目）与 Bulbapedia 来源链接。所有费用与时长均由「首次消耗（Initial Cost）」推算——新超级进化公布时，只需在 data/mega.json 里加一行（名称 + 首次消耗，可达超级最高的再标 superMax），其余自动生成。
zh-CN.mega.allHint: 点击任意一行查看该宝可梦的完整信息。
zh-CN.clock.title: 世界时钟 · 时段筛选
zh-CN.clock.intro: 默认按「最早 → 最晚」列出各时区代表地。选择时段则筛选此刻当地处于该时段的地区；「结束」为上界且不含本身（如 14 → 17 = 14:00–17:00），可选到 24:00（当日结束）；跨午夜把「结束」设得比「起始」小（如 22 → 02）。
zh-CN.clock.foot: 列表覆盖 UTC+14 → −12 的全部时区，每档列出代表地点（同一时区可能多地并列）；精选地点为社区常用 PoGo 热点，坐标可点击跳转地图。各地时间按所在时区实时计算（含夏令时），仅供参考。
zh-CN.todo.title: 多账号 TODO
zh-CN.todo.intro: 每个账号一行，每项任务一列；勾选记录完成情况。账号名前的 ⏳ 可开始 2 小时 CD：点击开始，进行中点击可切换「剩余 ⇄ 开始时间」，长按取消。数据只保存在本机浏览器（localStorage），不会上传；勾选不会自动清空，需手动点「清空勾选」；清空后顶部日期会更新为当天（以你本机时间为准），在下次清空前保持不变，账号/任务列与进行中的 CD 始终保留。

en.reminder.intro: This browser only. No uploads, account grouping, or system notifications. Reminders and notes are deleted at the confirmed deadline.

en.drawer.label: Event details
en.mega.intro: Choose a Pokémon and enter how many times it has Mega Evolved. The planner compares three upgrade routes dynamically: wait through the full rest period for free (7 / 5 / 3 days), Mega Evolve once per day by spending Energy, or buy the level instantly. The static tables below show level costs, shared bonuses, instant-upgrade prices, and the Bulbapedia source. Every cost and duration is derived from the Initial Cost—when a new Mega Evolution is announced, only one row is added to data/mega.json (name + Initial Cost, plus superMax when officially eligible); everything else is generated automatically.
en.mega.allHint: Select any row to view that Pokémon's full details.
en.clock.title: World Clock · Time-window Filter
en.clock.intro: By default, representative locations are listed from earliest to latest time zone. Choose a time window to show places whose local time is currently inside it. End is exclusive (for example, 14 → 17 means 14:00–17:00), and 24:00 means the end of the day. To cross midnight, set End earlier than Start (for example, 22 → 02).
en.clock.foot: The list covers every time zone from UTC+14 to UTC−12, with representative locations for each offset. Featured locations are community-used Pokémon GO hotspots; coordinates open in Maps. Local times are calculated live in each time zone, including daylight-saving changes, and are provided for reference only.
en.todo.title: Multi-account TODO
en.todo.intro: Each account is a row and each task is a column; check cells to track completion. The ⏳ beside an account starts a 2-hour cooldown: tap to start, tap while active to toggle Remaining ⇄ Start Time, or long-press to cancel. Data stays only in this browser (localStorage) and is never uploaded. Checks are cleared only when you press Clear Checks; that action stamps today's local date, while accounts, task columns, and active cooldowns remain.
